verdict.rationale: Browserbase's own site advertises a fetch capability that converts any URL into markdown as well as HTML or JSON, so developers can get markdown output instead of raw HTML. The support comes from a single marketing line with no API reference or examples. missing for 10: detailed API docs for the markdown fetch output, evidence the markdown is clean (boilerplate/nav stripped), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can receive scraped content as clean markdown instead of raw HTML

citations.quote: Quickly fetch web context for your agent by converting any URL into HTML, JSON or markdown
